snippet.title: Puzzling Places - Monthly Pack #3: Churches of Catalonia
snippet.description:
Introducing the Monthly Pack #3: Churches of Catalonia - bringing you 4 new puzzles from all around the world for 3.99$! 

Available to purchase NOW in-app or through the Quest / PS VR stores! https://www.oculus.com/experiences/quest/3931148300302917/

This DLC Puzzle Pack includes:
- Church of Santa Maria (Cardet, Catalonia, Spain)
- Church of Sant Feliu (Barruera, Catalonia, Spain)
- Church of Santa Eulalia (Erill la Vall, Catalonia, Spain)
- Church of Sant Quirc (Durro, Catalonia, Spain)

Special thanks to Giravolt for providing photogrammetry scans. Detailed information about each puzzle: https://puzzlingplaces.ghost.io/m3/
